svg.title: Identity security posture management: a continuous loop
svg.desc: Identity security posture management runs as a continuous loop. Step 1 discovers every identity, including people, service accounts, AI agents, and OAuth grants. Step 2 correlates them into a graph of owners, accounts, and effective permissions. Step 3 finds weak posture such as dormant, orphaned, or unused access, toxic combinations, and missing MFA. Step 4 ranks findings by exposure, meaning attack paths to crown jewels, not by alert count. Step 5 fixes findings with guardrails, automating only low-risk, reversible hygiene. Step 6 verifies that nothing broke and scans again. Step 7 places ISPM among related tools: identity governance and administration asks who should have access, ISPM asks whether posture is risky now, identity threat detection and response asks whether an attack is underway, and AI security posture management asks whether AI models and data are exposed.
svg.text: Identity security posture management: a continuous loop
